scheme_name: Scheme for assistance for Start Ups/ Innovation: Assistance for Skill Development
other_conditions: Applicant must be an individual or a group of individuals with an innovative idea or concept
The idea must be recommended by an approved Nodal Institution
Applicant must be a startup operating in any sector such as science, technology, engineering, agriculture, healthcare, etc.
Startups receiving benefits under the Student Startup and Innovation Policy (SSIP) are also eligible
benefits_summary: Financial assistance up to ₹1,00,000 on a reimbursement basis for skill‑development training programs.
